EventHistorical

Event

What Happened

  • During the ancient Wizarding Wars, a hero named Diego was summoned from another world
  • Diego was the world's most talented swordsman
  • He ended the wars by defeating the lich Jon the Summoner
  • Diego became a legendary figure who helped found the kingdom

Key Takeaways

  • Diego came from the same world as the party
  • His legacy is the reason the artifacts can only be unlocked by otherworlders
